iDEP: Identifying Differentially Expressed Genes

If this site has contributed to your work, please cite our article:

Ge, S.X., Son, E.W. & Yao, R. iDEP: an integrated web application for differential expression and pathway analysis of RNA-Seq data. BMC Bioinformatics 19, 534 (2018). https://doi.org/10.1186/s12859-018-2486-6

Summary

Read Counts data were analyzed using iDEP v2.4.3. The data was first filtered to remove reads below 0.5 CPM in at least 1 sample. Then the data was transformed with EdgeR using a pseudocount of 4. Missing values were imputed using geneMedian.

After mapping, there are 42278 unique genes in 31 samples. Of the 30756 genes passed filter, 30695 were converted to Ensembl/STRING gene IDs in our database. The remaining 61 genes were kept in the data using original IDs.

Differential expression analysis was performed using DESeq2 with an FDR cutoff of 0.1 and a minimum fold-change threshold of 2. Standard Wald test was used and independent filtering was disabled.

# DESeq2 script generated by iDEP on Wed Dec 10 15:18:55 2025
# Please cite https://doi.org/10.1186/s12859-018-2486-6

# R version 4.5.1 (2025-06-13)
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("BiocManager")  # v. 1.30.26
if (!require("DESeq2", quietly = TRUE))
  BiocManager::install("DESeq2")  # v. 1.48.2
library(DESeq2) # D.E.G.
FC <- 2 # Fold-change cutoff
FDR <- 0.1 # FDR cutoff
alpha <- 0.1 # independent filtering, default

#  Prepare data --------------------
# Use the "Converted counts" button in the Pre-Process tab
# to download the filtered counts file with gene IDs converted to Ensembl.
raw_counts = read.csv("converted_counts_data.csv")
row.names(raw_counts) <- raw_counts$User_ID
raw_counts <- raw_counts[, -(1:3)] # delete 3 columns of IDs
str(raw_counts)

# Factors coded: condition --> A, preservative --> B, genotype --> C, Treatment_genotype --> D
col_data <- data.frame(
  "A" = c("0_CGY", "0_CGY", "0_CGY", "0_CGY", "0_CGY", "0_CGY", "0_CGY", "0_CGY", "40_CGY", "40_CGY", "40_CGY", "40_CGY", "40_CGY", "40_CGY", "40_CGY", "40_CGY", "0_CGY", "0_CGY", "0_CGY", "0_CGY", "0_CGY", "0_CGY", "0_CGY", "0_CGY", "40_CGY", "40_CGY", "40_CGY", "40_CGY", "40_CGY", "40_CGY", "40_CGY"),
  "B" = c("DRS", "DRS", "DRS", "DRS", "RL", "RL", "RL", "RL", "DRS", "DRS", "DRS", "DRS", "RL", "RL", "RL", "RL", "DRS", "DRS", "DRS", "DRS", "RL", "RL", "RL", "RL", "DRS", "DRS", "DRS", "DRS", "RL", "RL", "RL"),
  "C" = c("ANTHO_LESS", "ANTHO_LESS", "ANTHO_LESS", "ANTHO_LESS", "ANTHO_LESS", "ANTHO_LESS", "ANTHO_LESS", "ANTHO_LESS", "ANTHO_LESS", "ANTHO_LESS", "ANTHO_LESS", "ANTHO_LESS", "ANTHO_LESS", "ANTHO_LESS", "ANTHO_LESS", "ANTHO_LESS", "WT", "WT", "WT", "WT", "WT", "WT", "WT", "WT", "WT", "WT", "WT", "WT", "WT", "WT", "WT"),
  "D" = c("ANTHO_LESS_&_0_CGY", "ANTHO_LESS_&_0_CGY", "ANTHO_LESS_&_0_CGY", "ANTHO_LESS_&_0_CGY", "ANTHO_LESS_&_0_CGY", "ANTHO_LESS_&_0_CGY", "ANTHO_LESS_&_0_CGY", "ANTHO_LESS_&_0_CGY", "ANTHO_LESS_&_40_CGY", "ANTHO_LESS_&_40_CGY", "ANTHO_LESS_&_40_CGY", "ANTHO_LESS_&_40_CGY", "ANTHO_LESS_&_40_CGY", "ANTHO_LESS_&_40_CGY", "ANTHO_LESS_&_40_CGY", "ANTHO_LESS_&_40_CGY", "WT_&_0_CGY", "WT_&_0_CGY", "WT_&_0_CGY", "WT_&_0_CGY", "WT_&_0_CGY", "WT_&_0_CGY", "WT_&_0_CGY", "WT_&_0_CGY", "WT_&_40_CGY", "WT_&_40_CGY", "WT_&_40_CGY", "WT_&_40_CGY", "WT_&_40_CGY", "WT_&_40_CGY", "WT_&_40_CGY")
)
row.names(col_data) <- colnames(raw_counts)
col_data

#Set reference level 
col_data[, 4] <- as.factor(col_data[, 4])
col_data[, 4] <- relevel(col_data[, 4], "WT_&_0_CGY")
col_data[, 4] <- as.factor(col_data[, 4])
col_data[, 4] <- relevel(col_data[, 4], "ANTHO_LESS_&_0_CGY")

# Run DESeq2--------------------
DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
   countData = raw_counts,
   colData = col_data,
   design = ~  D + B 
)
dds = DESeq2::DESeq(dds) 

# Extract results--------------------

# Comparison 1 of 4:  ANTHO_LESS_&_0_CGY-WT_&_0_CGY
res <- DESeq2::results(dds,
  contrast = c("D", "ANTHO_LESS_&_0_CGY", "WT_&_0_CGY"),
  independentFiltering = FALSE,
  alpha = alpha
)
# Examine results 
summary(res)
plotMA(res)
plotCounts(dds, gene = which.min(res$padj), intgroup = colnames(col_data)[2])
res <- subset(res, padj < FDR & abs(log2FoldChange) > log2(FC)) # Select
table(sign(res$log2FoldChange)) # N. of genes Down, Up
res <- res[order(-res$log2FoldChange), ] #sort
head(res) #top upregulated
tail(res) #top downregulated
